column3: a camera element not in form: not read, rather than absent — the pusher keeps the receivers and push of the last read element; none read — does not push, waits, the log

the primary's element not in form: not read, rather than absent — the backup keeps the state by the element read earlier since the start (lapse); no earlier one — the backup records (no knowledge at all)
puts the copy of the section as it came, does not judge the value of an element: the unreadable is judged by the reader; the next answer of the door overwrites the row
